SMTO-WEB-0015 — These Web search settings are from a different SMTO version

GUID: 15a126bc-81a2-4564-a1c5-1602ce85ad15
Slug: web-configuration-unsupported
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web

What happened

  • The saved Web search settings use a format or a search provider type that this version of SMTO doesn't know. SMTO didn't change your saved settings.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you recently moved back to an older SMTO or restored settings from a newer one, install the same or a newer SMTO version than the one that saved them. Settings saved by a newer SMTO can use a format or provider this version doesn't understand.
  2. Otherwise open Settings › Setup › Capabilities, select Configure Web, and set each provider's Provider type to one listed there, such as DuckDuckGo, SearXNG or Brave Search. Then select Save. Only provider types built into this version can be used for searches.
  3. Don't edit the saved settings file by hand to change its version number. Forcing the version can make SMTO misread the settings instead of safely refusing them.

What success looks like

  • Save succeeds, Configure Web shows Ready, and a web search returns results.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who installed SMTO, noting any recent upgrade, downgrade or restore. Keep the original settings; don't overwrite them with a guess.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Web configuration was rejected because its schema_version is not the integer 1 or a provider_type is not registered in this runtime.

What this means

  • Configuration supplies a schema version other than exact integer one, or provider lookup requests an unregistered implementation type. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • Configuration supplies a schema version other than exact integer one, or provider lookup requests an unregistered implementation type.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare schema_version and provider_type with the installed registry.

How to fix it

  • WebConfiguration.exact_version in src/agent_runtime/skills/web/models.py accepts only schema_version 1, and WebSearchProviderRegistry.get in providers.py accepts only registered types (searxng, duckduckgo, brave). Run the SMTO version that wrote the configuration or migrate it through the supported path, choosing a registered provider_type; do not coerce the stored version.
  • Use a provider type supported by the installed version or upgrade through the supported configuration migration path.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported version and registered provider type validate without coercing an incompatible configuration.

What not to do

  • Do not overwrite the original configuration with a guessed schema version.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
